response.overview: After being tricked into listening to a mysterious piece of music, Ray finds himself drawn into a disturbing encounter with a mysterious entity full of knowledge. As strange events begin to unfold around him, Ray struggles to separate reality from what the King wants him to believe.  What begins as a simple encounter quickly becomes a descent into paranoia, manipulation, and something far beyond his understanding.
response.tagline: When the truth is better left unknown
response.title: Red Halls Are White
